relationships.subject: GLRX3
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, GLRX3, via its catalytic Cys148 residue, catalyses the deglutathionylation of high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) at the Cys106 site.

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: This modification converts HMGB1 into a potent agonist for the toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)-myeloid differentiation factor 2 (MD2) complex

relationships.subject: TAK-242
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, oral γ-glutamylcysteine or pharmacologic TLR4 blockade (TAK-242) effectively alleviated refractory hypersensitivity in aged models.

key_findings: Satellite glial GLRX3 is upregulated in aged mice in chronic OIPN and deglutathionylates HMGB1, making it a TLR4-MD2 agonist.
GLRX3-HMGB1-TLR4 axis drives age-biased neuropathic pain; TLR4 blockade relieves hypersensitivity in aged mice.
